description: A lawn mowing service provides neighborhood services using small teams and large teams. A small team requires 3 employees and can mow 50 sq ft of lawn. A large team requires 5 employees and can mow 80 sq ft of lawn. The company has 150 employees available. Because most people have smaller lawns in the city, the number of small teams must be at least 3 times as much as the number of large teams. In addition, to make sure the company can meet all demands, there has to be at least 6 large teams and at least 10 small teams. How many of each team type should be used to maximize the amount of lawn that can be mowed?

EmployeesPerSmallTeam.definition: Number of employees required per small team

AreaMowedSmallTeam.definition: Area mowed by a small team

EmployeesPerLargeTeam.definition: Number of employees required per large team

AreaMowedLargeTeam.definition: Area mowed by a large team

RatioSmallToLargeTeams.definition: Minimum ratio of small teams to large teams

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of lawn area (in square feet) that can be mowed by the small and large teams combined."

constraints.description: 3 * (number of small teams) + 5 * (number of large teams) ≤ 150
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    EmployeesPerSmallTeam * numberSmallTeams +
    EmployeesPerLargeTeam * numberLargeTeams
    <= TotalEmployees
)

constraints.description: Number of small teams ≥ 3 * (number of large teams)
Number of small teams and number of large teams must be integers

numberSmallTeams.definition: Number of small teams to be used

numberLargeTeams.definition: Number of large teams to be used
